summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of Class XXX Notes between May 12-15, 2026. A total of Ps. 8,753,188,541.11 (US$6,284,686 par) was repurchased at an average price of 99.68% of nominal value. The notes were originally issued under YPF's Frequent Issuer framework in July 2024 (US$185M) and April 2025 (additional US$204M), maturing July 2026. The repurchased notes will be held in portfolio. This is an ordinary debt repurchase, not a special situation, and does not represent a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring event. As a routine open-market repurchase of maturing debt, it requires no further analysis.
